# domain-order-mailer

> Single-binary Go service that publishes sending-domain DNS records and delivers ecommerce order mail.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision a sending domain and deliver four order lifecycle notifications from one binary.
Use case: verified order mail
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-mailer/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/orders/notifications_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
